tasks.title: Merge user data from three sources
tasks.objective: Read, parse, merge, and resolve conflicts from three user data sources (JSON, CSV, Parquet) into a unified Parquet file and conflict report.

factSources.description: Source C (Parquet) has fields: userId, userName, email, joined, active

outputContracts.description: Output merged Parquet file at /app/merged_users.parquet with columns: user_id (int), name (str), email (str), created_date (str YYYY-MM-DD), status (str, optional). One row per unique user, conflict resolution by source priority.
Conflict report JSON at /app/conflicts.json with total_conflicts count and conflicts array. Each conflict has user_id, field, values per source, selected value.
Merged dataset schema: user_id (integer), name (string), email (string), created_date (string YYYY-MM-DD), status (string, optional)

maps.title: Merge user data from three sources

nodes.title: Inspect input data sources
nodes.contextSummary: Read and understand the schemas and contents of source_a (JSON), source_b (CSV), and source_c (Parquet) user data files.

nodes.title: Validate merged output files
nodes.contextSummary: Run Python validation to confirm merged_users.parquet and conflicts.json have correct schema, data, and conflict resolution.

nodes.title: Create pytest validation script
nodes.contextSummary: Create test_merge.py with pytest tests that validate merged_users.parquet and conflicts.json.

nodes.title: Run pytest validation
nodes.contextSummary: Run pytest test_merge.py to validate the merged output files.

nodes.title: Final summary
nodes.contextSummary: Provide final user-facing summary of the merge operation.

nodes.title: Implement merge logic
nodes.contextSummary: Read source_c parquet, merge all three sources by user_id with priority a>b>c, output merged_users.parquet and conflicts.json.

nodes.title: Run merge script and validate outputs
nodes.contextSummary: Run python merge_users.py and verify merged_users.parquet and conflicts.json are created correctly with the right schema and conflict resolution.

nodes.title: Execute merge script and generate outputs
nodes.contextSummary: Run the merge_users.py script to generate merged_users.parquet and conflicts.json output files.

nodes.title: Validate merged output files
nodes.contextSummary: Read and verify merged_users.parquet schema, data types, date formats, and conflicts.json format and counts.

nodes.title: Basic output verification
nodes.contextSummary: Quick verification: read conflics.json with ConvertFrom-Json to confirm valid JSON and correct structure.

nodes.title: Run final validation and record results
nodes.contextSummary: Run inline python validation script to verify merged_users.parquet schema/data and conflicts.json content.

nodes.title: Final summary
nodes.contextSummary: Provide final user-facing summary of the completed merge operation.

results.body:
## Merge Complete — Final Summary

All three data sources have been successfully merged, validated, and output to the workspace.

### Data Sources

| Source | Format | Priority | Records | Users |
|--------|--------|----------|---------|-------|
| source_a/users.json | JSON | Highest | 2 | 101, 102 |
| source_b/users.csv | CSV | Medium | 2 | 101, 103 |
| source_c/users.parquet | Parquet | Lowest | 2 | 101, 104 |

### Field Mappings Applied

- `id` / `userId` / `user_id` → **user_id** (integer)
- `full_name` / `name` / `userName` → **name** (string)
- `email` / `email_address` → **email** (string)
- `registration_date` / `created_at` / `joined` → **created_date** (YYYY-MM-DD)
- `status` / `is_active` / `active` → **status** (string, optional)

### Output Files

**`merged_users.parquet`** — 4 unique users with conflicts resolved by priority:

| user_id | name | email | created_date | status |
|---------|------|-------|-------------|--------|
| 101 | John Doe | john@a.com | 2024-01-15 | active |
| 102 | Jane Smith | jane@a.com | 2024-02-20 | inactive |
| 103 | Bob Wilson | bob@b.com | 2024-03-01 | true |
| 104 | Alice Brown | alice@c.com | 2024-04-01 | true |

**`conflicts.json`** — 4 conflicts detected (all for user 101, who appeared in all three sources):

| Field | source_a | source_b | source_c | Selected |
|-------|----------|----------|----------|----------|
| name | John Doe | John Doe | John D. | John Doe |
| email | john@a.com | john@b.com | john@c.com | john@a.com |
| created_date | 2024-01-15 | 2024-01-10 | 2024-01-20 | 2024-01-15 |
| status | active | true | true | active |

### Validation

**9/9 pytest tests passed** covering:
- Parquet file schema and data types
- All 4 unique user IDs present
- Date format compliance (YYYY-MM-DD)
- Conflict report structure and count
- Conflict resolution priority (source_a > source_b > source_c)
- User 101 field values confirmed from highest priority source
